summary_1line: Draupadi hosts Jayadratha, who becomes infatuated and urges her to abandon the exiled Pandavas; she angrily rebukes his insults and waits for her husbands.

image_candidates.scene_text: Jayadratha steps into the lonely forest hermitage and gazes at Draupadi standing in the doorway, radiant and stern.
Draupadi, brows furrowed and eyes blazing with anger, rebukes Jayadratha inside the quiet woodland cottage.
Jayadratha stands arrogantly beside his chariot outside the hermitage, urging Draupadi to leave the exiled Pandavas and ride away with him.
